summary: Round 3 of the security review, delta only. The change over f497917 holds four files: the new adversarial test file, adjudicate.ts, review-set.ts, and plan.md. No new write path appears and no symlink or set-id refusal is weakened. adjudicate.ts now builds the claim key from the same JSON tuple that the claim id hashes, so the queue dedups on the claim identity. review-set.ts adds one lint failure for a plant range that holds no added line, and the line prints only the diff id and the plant id. The queue item holds no route name and no private path. The four single-file suites pass at HEAD. The round 2 nit P3B2-1 carries open.
nonblocking_findings: P3B2-1 [Nit] review-b: nothing enforces the D9 order of the key SHA-256. review-set.ts still computes key_sha256 from the key bytes at lint time, and adjudicate.ts rewrites the key files after the lint, so a lint run before the apply publishes a hash that the apply invalidates. The delta of 8fee6bb changed neither line. The phase plan controls the order at task 4.13: the apply runs first, then the lint runs again, then the orchestrator commits the manifest. Carries round 2 P3B2-1 and round 1 P3B1-6. Non-blocking.
